newsitem.title: USA: Nevada approves Sierra Pacific Barrick deal.
newsitem.headline: Nevada approves Sierra Pacific Barrick deal.

text.p: A five-year contract between Sierra Pacific Power Co and its largest electric customer, Barrick Goldstrike Mines, Inc, was approved by the Nevada Public Service Commission, the utility said Friday.
The contract, which secures Sierra Pacific as the exclusive electric provider for the project, can be extended for up to 20 years.

The Barrick deal is the first of a number of contracts awaiting approval by the state agency that Sierra Pacific has negotiated with its largest electric customers under a new rate tariff, which was also approved Friday.
The new rates are based on cost-of-service and require qualified customers to pay for those utility facilities specifically "dedicated" to serve them.
